slides.headline: SHE BUILT HER ENTIRE SALES FUNNEL IN ONE NIGHT WITH THESE 6 PROMPTS
slides.kicker: ONE SOLOPRENEUR WAS QUOTED $10,000. SHE PAID $0.
slides.image_prompt: Two bare hands mid-ripping a thick printed manuscript, pages bursting apart, hundred-dollar bills scattered on a dark marble desk. Overhead spotlight. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain. No readable text. Accent: warm gold bills against near-black marble.

slides.headline: 1) WRITE THE LEAD MAGNET TITLE PEOPLE ACTUALLY DOWNLOAD
slides.body: A freelance copywriter charges $150 to $300 just to name a lead magnet. Paste this: "Act as a conversion copywriter. My audience is [X]. Write 10 lead magnet titles that each promise one fast, specific result."

slides.headline: 2) WRITE THE LANDING PAGE IN ONE SHOT
slides.body: A landing page designer quotes $1,500 to $3,000 for one page. Paste this: "Write a landing page for [product] targeting [audience]. Include: headline, subheadline, 3 benefit bullets, social proof placeholder, and one CTA."

slides.headline: 3) WRITE THE WELCOME EMAIL PEOPLE ACTUALLY READ
slides.body: Welcome emails often hit open rates above 60%, the highest of any sequence email. Paste this: "Write a welcome email for [brand] subscribers. Make them feel seen, preview what's coming, and give one quick win. Under 200 words."
slides.image_prompt: Close overhead of a smartphone on dark espresso wood, screen glowing with long email-scroll paragraph blocks — no legible text — one finger mid-swipe down through it. Documentary, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural texture, slight film grain. Accent: warm amber phone glow against near-black wood.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE 5 EMAILS THAT WARM STRANGERS INTO BUYERS
slides.body: Email copywriters charge $300 to $500 per email, so five emails run $1,500 to $2,500 to outsource. Paste this: "Write a 5-email nurture sequence for [product]: story, education, social proof, objection handling, soft pitch, one email per goal."
slides.image_prompt: Five ivory envelopes in a slight arc on dark oak, the rightmost being opened by a hand lifting its flap, a folded hundred-dollar bill visible inside. Documentary, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. No text. Accent: ivory against deep espresso brown.

slides.headline: 5) WRITE THE SALES PAGE THAT CLOSES
slides.body: Top sales copywriters quote $5,000 to $15,000 for one page. Paste this: "Write a long-form sales page for [product]: story lead, problem agitation, solution reveal, proof stack, offer, guarantee, and CTA."

slides.headline: 6) WRITE THE UPSELL THAT DOUBLES YOUR AVERAGE ORDER
slides.body: A single upsell can double revenue per customer without a new sale. Paste this: "Write a one-click upsell for [upsell offer]. Buyer just purchased [main offer]. Make it feel like the obvious next step. Under 150 words."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You'll want these prompts when you build each piece. Come back to this post. Daily AI news and real skills right here

hook_tournament.why: The $10,000 comparison is a concrete gut-check that makes you stop—it's not just 'build a funnel' but 'replace a $10k hire,' which lands instantly. [4] is close with its specificity, but the actual dollar figure beats a generic promise every time at 2am.

[2] is close with a stronger concrete benefit, but "fire" beats "write" for raw impact on tired eyes at 2am.
